title: Ion-directed polymer/inorganic interphase with enriched charge for stable and high-rate Zn anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,3629-3639
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01602B, Paper
Meihua Zhu, Sitian Ku, Qing Ran, Houhou Huang, Ningzhi Cao, Fu-Quan Bai, Xing-You Lang, Danming Chao, Ming Feng
A polymer/inorganic interphase provides enriched charge and directed Zn2+ deposition, endowing Zn anodes with high-rate performance and excellent stability.
